sections.heading: Spot Accepted and Waitlisted for other session
sections.html:
Thank you for filling out the initial Enrollment Information. To complete your enrollment, you must pay a $200 PER FAMILY (not per child) Enrollment Fee within 5 business days of completing this form.

Click below to pay online. Alternatively, you can pay in the office or mail within 5 business days.

Your enrollment will not be final until we have received the $200 family enrollment fee.

Note: If you have are enrolling multiple children, you must complete a separate form for each child.

Click HERE to return to the Seedlings Enrollment Form.

Click HERE to return to the Little Seedlings Enrollment Form.

If you have any questions, comments or concerns, Ashley or Susan would be happy to speak with you. You can get in touch with them by email or calling 561 501-6615.
